prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic candid outdoor vacation snapshot with natural skin texture, sand detail, and a carefree beach-influencer aesthetic.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with long straight auburn-red hair, fair freckled skin, and a fit curvy physique with a natural feminine silhouette. She wears a black string bikini set with triangular cups and side-tie bottoms. Preserve realistic pores, freckles, sand grains on skin, and slightly wind-tousled hair.
prompt.composition_elements: The subject lies prone on a sandy tropical beach, supporting her upper body with extended arms and turning her head over her left shoulder toward the camera with a gentle approachable smile. Frame from thighs to head in a slightly low, rear-side medium shot. Show textured white sand, small pebbles, ocean meeting the shore, dark rocks at left, and a blue sky with white cumulus clouds.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural daylight softened by clouds, overhead ambient light, gentle contact shadows beneath the body, natural warm skin tones, turquoise ocean, blue sky, beige-white sand, and a relaxed confident summery atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic candid photography, approximately 50–85mm portrait lens, natural perspective without wide-angle distortion, clear separation from the horizon, high-fidelity skin and sand texture, natural-light travel-influencer aesthetic.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic candid photography of an adult woman with long straight auburn-red hair and fair skin with natural freckles on her face and shoulders. She has a fit curvy physique and natural feminine silhouette, wearing a black string bikini set with triangular cups and side-tie bottoms. Preserve realistic skin texture, visible pores, freckles, sand grains on the skin, and slightly wind-tousled hair. She lies prone on a tropical beach, supporting her upper body with extended arms, turning her head over her left shoulder to look directly at the camera with a gentle approachable smile. Capture a medium shot from the thighs up from a slightly low rear-side angle, with textured white sand, small pebbles, ocean meeting the shore, dark rocks on the left, and expansive blue sky with white cumulus clouds. Natural daylight diffused by clouds, gentle shadows, natural body physics, turquoise ocean, warm sand tones, relaxed confident carefree beach-vacation mood, 50–85mm portrait perspective.
